pageLead: A nurse sets the target period, current weight, and target gain. The pregnant patient can record weight three times a day to track how much weight has increased during the period.
planLead: Set the starting weight, target period, and target gain first. This screen tracks weight gain within that period.
statusInitial: Once you set the period, you can check the weight gain for that period here.
statusNeedPlan: Please set the start date, starting weight, end date, and target weight gain.
statusNoRecords: Once weight records are added, progress and gain will appear here.
statusLosing: Weight is below the starting point. Please also check physical condition and food intake.
statusOk: The trend is currently not far from the target. Keep watching through the period.
statusNearGoal: The patient is getting close to the goal. Watch the remaining gain carefully.
statusOverGoal: The target gain has been exceeded. Please review the plan and current lifestyle.
recordLead: The pregnant patient can record weight three times a day: morning, noon, and evening. Only records within the set period are shown here.
tableEmpty: There are no records in this period yet.
promptInvalidDate: The target end date must be on or after the start date.
promptFillWeight: Please enter the date, time slot, and weight.
progressNoRecords: There are no records in this period yet.
